selected_evidence.summary: Shows the active LUKS2 AES-XTS mapping, XFS filesystem, persistent configuration, protected key file, and mounted volume.

selected_evidence.requirement: Automatic unlock and mount at boot
selected_evidence.summary: Systemd successfully activated the closed mapping; the current-boot journal records automatic cryptsetup activation followed by mounting /srv/secure, with persisted data readable.

selected_evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel retained
selected_evidence.summary: AlmaLinux 9.6 and kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6.x86_64 are identical before and after configuration and restart.

Healthy baseline boot ID 4a743885-c59f-43ee-afde-ef96f7bea723 was captured, the safe reboot was acknowledged, and execution returned with changed boot ID 8835ef9a-dc2d-4fa4-886a-759d07e0e4be. The cryptsetup and mount units were active, marker data persisted, and no units were failed.
